Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, LOKESHWAR SINGH PANTA
OF H.P. v. MUSHTAQ AHMAD MARCH 26, 2007 B [DR.ARIJITPASAYATANDLOKESHWARSINGHPANTA,JJ.] Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973--s. 378(3)-Application seeking leave to appeal-Against order of acquittal-Summary dismissal of the c application by High Court-On appeal, held: Absence of reason has rendered 1950-Article 136. Judgment-Need to give reasons-Held: right to reason is an D indispensable part of a sound judicial system-Reasons introduce clarity in an otder-They are indicative of an application of mind by the Judicial forum-One of the statutory requirements of natural justice is speaking
